text: THE HOME PAGE'S SECTIONS HAVE EDGES AGAIN. Reordering the sections on 24 Sep 2026 left two long runs of unbroken white — Our Offerings into Our Organisations at 1,444px, and Recent Documents into the centre finder at 1,929px, the second with 160px of empty white between the last link of one section and the heading of the next and nothing to say a section had ended. The page alternates its grounds precisely so a reader does not have to reach a heading to know that: Our Organisations and Recent Documents take the muted ground, and the middle of the page alternates white, muted, white, muted, white from the scheme portals to the helplines. The longest unbroken white is now 1,157px and it is one section, the centre finder, which is tall because it holds a map and a list. Nothing else changed — no spacing, no type, no component. The corner radii were audited in the same pass and left alone: 8px on controls, 12px on cards, 16px on panels is a legible ladder, not drift.
